study type: multicenter, non-interventional, prospective, single-cohort, post-marketing surveillance study
outcome: pictorial blood loss assessment chart (PBAC) scores
cohort: Japanese women with dysmenorrhea and/or heavy menstrual bleeding (HMB) who underwent insertion of the levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system (LNG-IUS) 52 mg.
finding: The LNG-IUS significantly improved the quality of life (QOL) of patients with dysmenorrhea, heavy menstrual bleeding, or both, regardless of patient background characteristics.
